tablet_reference: projects/vehicle_data/dashboard/docs/design.md: portrait-mounted tablet, 800 × 1280 CSS pixels; physical DPR unconfirmed.
capture_method: browser_clean (Playwright Chromium), 800 × 1280 at DPR 1, Roboto and Roboto Mono loaded in the capture browser, browser clock pinned to an illustrative afternoon (2026-10-28 15:30 CDT). The current build was served locally by web_v2 (cache-only, warning chat off) over a forwarded broker socket; every data route was answered in the browser by dashboard/tools/demo_capture.mjs and the sequence is dashboard/tools/readme_shots.playwright.js.
data_notice: All images show illustrative demo data, never a live drive, diagnosis, model response or service action. Values come from dashboard/tools/demo_data.mjs (the highway scene, whose readings agree with each other), demo_views.mjs (trips, history baselines, parked state, service records, radar reference), demo_events.mjs and demo_assistant.mjs (saved events and simulated conversations), plus the tracked test fixture summary-v2.json with its times moved to the capture time (diagnostic codes, broker and bus status, 7- and 30-day statistics).
primary_trip_source: The illustrative drive in dashboard/tools/demo_data.mjs: 42 minutes and 39.8 miles at 63 mph, ≈ 16.4 mpg. Running images (01, 02, 04-08, 10-13, 16, 17) show it in progress; parked images (03, 09, 14, 15) are 50 minutes after it ended; 18 is stopped with the engine idling.
suggested_public_caption: Van telemetry dashboard — tablet UI with illustrative demo data.
safety: No vehicle actions, scan, calibration, warning installation, maintenance save, deployment or service change. The capture browser aborted every request that was not GET or HEAD and answered the one chat-opening POST locally; the listener log shows only GET requests.
